verdict.rationale: Paperspace is a GPU cloud and ML platform, so in-product AI insights or suggestions are a fair question for it, but the evidence shows no such feature. The closest items do not count: DigitalOcean MCP servers let external clients reason about infrastructure, which is an external client capability on the host platform rather than inside the product. Deploying LLMs or running Notebooks are developer building blocks, not built-in insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
